calculation.description: Ranks assets by medium-term return multiplied by the balance between upside and downside realized return energy. Positive asymmetry rewards assets whose recent gains dominate losses; negative asymmetry penalizes downside-dominated paths. Uses only completed daily data.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.033893; 754 dates), 2023-2024 (0.024771; 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.023160; 574 dates). Longer-horizon decay is stronger than the daily signal. The 15-asset universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
